decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core spraying know-how, and its own R&D lets it interpret and refine early results, so it is likely kept.
The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established offer, has its own web page, and was field-tested on a construction site, so the firm can assimilate the feedback and keep improving it.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses the proven WIWA air motors, which places it squarely within existing knowledge and makes it easy to support and improve.

Fire protection flow monitoring builds on the firm's offer and fits its digitalization goals, and its dedicated page plus R&D cooperation support continued learning, though it is slightly further from core pumping expertise.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system is a recent launch close to the firm's core competence, so its early results can be interpreted and acted on.
